title: Skillet Chilli Fajitas
description: A spicy mexican dish made with kicked chilli peppers, crunchy vegetables, and irish skillet-cooked meat, served with a side of crusty bread. Perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Heat oil in the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced irish steak and cook for 3-4 minutes per side, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160°F (71°C).
Remove the steak from the skillet and set aside.
Add the diced onion and kicked chilli peppers to the skillet and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add the sliced crunchy bell peppers to the skillet and cook for an additional 2-3 minutes.
Return the cooked steak to the skillet and stir to combine with the vegetables.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve the fajitas hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
